context: Found 2026-10-24 during the develop recovery (#3385). Source: Advisor review ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/ci-wedge-review-20261024/report.md, prevention plan row 'Post-merge whole-tree policy validation'. Checked 2026-10-25: trunk.yml on develop 9a184b619 contains no comment-policy step.
description:
Problem: the whole-tree comment-policy scan (scripts/run_comment_policy.py --full) runs on PRs and nightly (.github/workflows/comment-policy-nightly.yml:20-42), but not in .github/workflows/trunk.yml. On 2026-10-24 a bad scope entry on develop was noticed only when unrelated PRs started failing their tooling check, with no run that named the commit that introduced it.

Outcome: every develop push runs the full scan, and a failure names the checked SHA, so normal trunk recovery points at the commit that added the violation. Detection only: prevention is comment-scope-head-policy-validation-20261025.

Decision gates:
1. Recovery path first. A scan failure turns Trunk red, which triggers the arm gate and the pr-open refusal. Before landing, confirm that make trunk-revert PR=<n> works for a policy-only culprit, including from a linked worktree (devloop-trunk-revert-nested-worktree). If revert is unusable, land after that fix.
2. Cost. Measure the full scan on a hosted runner. If it would lengthen Trunk's critical path, run it as a separate parallel job and record the duration.
3. Keep the nightly scan as a backstop; do not remove it.

Item guardrails: detection only; never auto-revert. No change to the PR-time check. No new required context, which is owner-only.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, after make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. No SKIP or --no-verify, no stand-in approvals, no ruleset edits or bypasses, no raw gh pr merge. Do not close and reopen, mass-rerun or rebase other pull requests.
